purpose: Turn the existing Mythical Void channel and launch material into one safe, practical first week without opening accounts, accepting terms or publishing for Kevin.

recommendedStart.reason: The true father-and-son beginning is personal, understandable and does not require another account or email subscription.
recommendedStart.exactPostBody:
My son and I started Mythical Void at home, using our imagination and today's AI tools.

We kept asking each other strange questions. What might live where gravity points sideways? Could a creature hear energy as music? How far could we take those ideas?

That small project became a real browser game.

You hatch an alien creature, explore six damaged realms, free their Guardians from the Void and decide what Project Beacon should become. It is free to play and still in early access, with no download or account.

AI helped us build, but people made the story, safety and release decisions. We have tested, rejected and rebuilt plenty along the way, and I am still improving it.

Some optional learning moments use credited public NASA material. NASA does not endorse the game.

See the story and play:
https://mythicalvoid.com/studio/

If LinkedIn shows the page picture, it is imagined artwork for the wider creature universe, not gameplay.

If you try the first minute, I would genuinely like to know what made sense and what did not.

Generated artwork must be clearly labelled and never presented as gameplay.

Do not add a channel link to the website until Kevin confirms ownership of the exact public address.
Do not automate public replies or private conversations.
